prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Locate Your Pet on Desktop", "Your pet lives right on your screen. Check your system tray to adjust visibility and toggle controls at any time.", "Look at the bottom right corner of your taskbar for pet quick settings."]
1: ["Choose Your Desktop Companion", "Select a companion personality to watch live animations before confirming adoption."]
2: ["Master Your Pet Controls", "Try these 3 quick shortcuts now to get comfortable managing your desktop friend.", "Complete Practice"]
3: ["How Would You Like to Create Your Pet?", "Pick a quick preset companion or customize your pet from scratch."]
4: ["For best results, upload a clear front-facing photo with good lighting and no background clutter."]
5: ["Use your primary email to instantly sync and preserve all existing desktop pets."]
6: ["Building Your Desktop Companion", "We are generating 3D behavior models and system tray integration."]
7: ["Your Pet is Ready + Bonus Toy Unlocked!", "Finish setup to receive an exclusive desktop ball toy inside your pet inventory.", "Free Starter Accessory"]
8: ["Bring an Interactive Friend to Your Desktop", "Choose preset companions or build a custom friend that lives right alongside your everyday work."]
9: ["We'll send a quick desktop sound alert when your pet finishes rendering."]

verdicts.problem: Asks for personal information (a user photo)
Asks for personal contact information (primary email)
